current_lane_rule.below_threshold: Change type 0 to outside-left 3 or outside-right 4 relative to the current ego pose; retain the obstacle for subsequent confidence/size filtering

historical_targets: Reclassify temporal-filter output using the current valid localization and world corners saved at the latest real observation. No filtered output is written back into raw history.
external_message: Internal world corners are cleared before publishing; retain original coordinates, dimensions, heading encoding, id, velocity, height and empty polygons. No message definition changes.
regressions: Zero overlap, boundary touch, small positive overlap, 19%, exactly 20%, adjacent float values and above-threshold overlap
Right and left outside-current-lane classification, rotated rectangles and retained SDK lane width
Existing lane 1 and lane 2 results retained even below 20%
Retained obstacles after ego lane change, heading changes and fresh matched observations
World geometry preserved during ego rotation, raw history unchanged and published polygons still empty
Missing/nonfinite internal geometry rolls back the appended frame and preserves the last publication
Existing confidence, dimensions, clock changes, stale localization, silent expiration and failure recovery regressions
limitation: Local tests use stubs generated from actual ROS messages and the existing real HDMap SDK. ROS1 transport, Orin build and vehicle execution have not been verified.
